summary: YPF Sociedad Anónima filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, reporting its condensed interim financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing discloses net profit, comprehensive income, shareholders' equity, and ownership details, including the controlling shareholder (Argentine National State). This is a routine financial reporting obligation, not a special situation. There are no terms related to acquisitions, divestitures, or other special-situation categories. The filing reflects a standard periodic update; no event-driven action is announced. This is classified as a routine current report.
